thread:
Nora: quick QA: on phones the sampler overlay blocks the p95 drag handle and the heatmap legend doesn't indicate sampling rate.
Eli: saw it. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/legend-dock. touch target measures ~26px.
Chen: proposal: dock the sampler in the legend on small widths, show a tiny "sampled 10%" chip, and keep chart layout stable (no reflow).
Sam: accessibility: hit area should be 44px, visible focus ring, and aria-label should include mode + rate, e.g. "Sampling: Adaptive, 10% sampled". announce changes with a polite live region.
Nora: microcopy: full tooltip: "Sampling: Adaptive 12 balances latency and fidelity"; compact: "Sampling: Adaptive"; chip: "10% sampled" or "1/10". provide length guidance for i18n.
Eli: dev note: use invisible padding via ::before to avoid layout shifts. CSS sketch: `.sampler{width:24px;height:24px;position:relative}.sampler::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;}`
Chen: action items: 1) dock sampler into legend on narrow widths (owner: Chen) 2) add sampled chip + legend pattern (owner: Nora) 3) implement 44px hit area + focus ring + aria (owner: Eli) 4) copy + i18n notes (owner: Sam).
Sam: I'll post copy variants and max-length table by EOD.
Eli: will open a small PR for hit area and keyboard announce tests.
DesignBot: calendar invite created for 2026-04-14 09:00 PT for visual sign-off.
Nora: closing thread; reopen if blockers.
